purpose: Conservative escalation support for a care-manager workflow; not diagnosis or autonomous triage.

outcomes.POSSIBLE_EMERGENCY: Escalate to clinician/emergency protocol; do not create a lower-acuity recommendation.
outcomes.CLINICAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED: No automated clearance. A qualified clinician/care manager must review current symptoms and context.
outcomes.INSUFFICIENT_CLINICAL_DATA: Current clinical data are unavailable or incomplete; obtain clinician review before navigation.
